Not only that, but the owner accommodated my repair in a timely fashion , allowing me to not miss any work or have any significant downtime. This is my new favorite mechanic shop in New Bern.

reviews.author: Phallavuth Chea
reviews.text: I brought my 1989 Toyota pick up truck to Auto Service Experts for changing the timing bell and transmission oil. You won't be disappointed with the service he provided. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Jacqui Macy Hallford
reviews.text: Twice we have been to this shop. We highly recommend Myo. His turnaround was great and his service impeccable. His pricing is the best in town!

reviews.author: Amir Abidi
reviews.text: They did an amazing job on my transmission! They were quick, professional, and my car runs perfectly now. The whole process was smooth, and I felt like I was in good hands from start to finish. Highly recommend!"

reviews.author: Amy G
reviews.text: Thank you SO MUCH for your quick, kind service on a Sunday! You worked us in so we could get back on the road and we really appreciate it! The car is doing great!

reviews.author: lucky bill
reviews.text: Hey! These guys here are very professional and they get things done in a timely manner compared to other shops in town. He did my o2 sesnor and fixed a melted wire in the 4th of July weekend And still had it done the next day. This is my new favourite shop and I will be coming back
